A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''Imperial officer''' served under [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] and [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. The [[Imperial officer|officer]] was stationed on an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]] during a [[Skirmish over Mykapo|skirmish]] over the [[planet]] [[Mykapo]].<ref name="Iron Squadron" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The officer is voiced by [[Steve Blum]], who also voiced [[Garazeb Orrelios]] in the series.
